main_body: autumn tree with orange foliage canopy and straight cylindrical trunk
top_band: upper lit crown of the central canopy mound, bright orange tones (rows 1-11)
evidence: The tree canopy is rendered in 3/4 view with overlapping rounded foliage puffs lit from above-left (rows 1-11 on the main crown) and shaded underneath (rows 12-18, and rows 27-28 overhanging the trunk), above a vertical trunk (rows 29-43).

style.evidence: While the canopy uses 5 orange-red steps and has some speckle texture, it consists of simple geometric puffs rather than the intricate individual leaf clusters of the Beodeul references. More importantly, the trunk (rows 28-44) is a rigid, straight vertical rectangle with a thick near-black outline, a flat base flange, and repetitive diagonal stripes instead of organic bark shading and flared roots, making the piece look stiff and sticker-like next to the references.
